function.name: check_availability
function.description: Get the free start times for one service on one day. Always call this before offering a time. Only offer times from free_times; never guess availability.

date.description: The day in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-11-23. Use get_current_datetime to turn words like tomorrow or next Monday into a date.
